citationText: 12. At one point, at MIT, we had a side-by-side demonstration of I versus P. using two 1000-line monitors, each displaying an image of the back of a dollar bill, captured in full resolution. Not a single one of the hundreds of television professionals who saw this demonstration had previously had any idea of the degree of interline flicker that is produced with video that does not have the reduced vertical resolution that is present in typical NTSC signals.
